The superlinear branch includes the finite equal-distribution power-sum lower bound. The equality-face and two-edge fixed-repair laws remain separately checked finite corollaries.
The complete uniform-lattice weak and unique winner boundaries, both equality tie-set classifications, and the one-step necessity witness are kernel-checked.

All three registered proof goals are represented by exact ratio, horizon, and critical-mesh equivalences.

For every exact first-zero cell, Lean derives the unique phase offset, exact KKT-mass equation, optimizer-to-normalized-profile identity at every index, powered-gap law, and strict active discrete convexity.

For every p>1, actual unique boundary-optimizer profiles are coordinatewise nondecreasing in the positive harmony-to-markedness ratio across arbitrary support changes. The first-zero horizon is exactly the least positive horizon whose actual unique optimizer profile remains identical under every extension, every later horizon is stable, adjacent phases paste continuously, and the actual minimum value is concave across all slack and active phase combinations.

Lean separates global family admission from local recovery: an actual consecutive admitted positive log-concave triple uniquely identifies the admitted exponent and ratio, every active pair recovers that ratio, support identifies only its phase cell, and common scale remains free.

The complete uniform solid-simplex lattices are finite and nonempty, exact minimizers exist and are canonically selected, lower-rounding supplies concrete density, and those selected minimizers converge to the unique continuum optimizer while preserving persistent exact nonidentity and eventual local-query identity under the stated hypotheses. The prime-denominator obstruction and global nearest-point proofs for all six decimal lattices remain exact.

For every fixed p>1, the complete normalized finite phase profile and its scaled decrement array converge uniformly over every active coordinate and every phase offset in [0,1). CHG-B7 supplies the exact reach asymptotic, while the analytic scaling module proves the limiting profile, density, unit mass, moments, and quantiles.

For every p>1 and every nonempty old support, the actual newly active optimizer coordinate has exact positive ratio-scale onset order q=1/(p-1) when 1<p<2 and order one when p>=2. The boundary and entering phases each have a unique optimizer, the support changes from k to k+1 without a winner tie, and the actual newborn coordinate is positive on entry but converges continuously to zero.

For every fixed finite N>0, Lean proves the actual unique full-vector optimizers and every later-coordinate limit in the fixed-ratio above, equality, and below branches and in every admitted first-order joint path c>-1; the variational selector and no-upcast witness are also exact.

For every fixed positive ratio, a canonical actual multiplier path is eventually the unique K_p=2 optimizer and extends uniquely to every longer horizon. Its sole positive follower is squeezed between the one-horizon envelope and that envelope divided by 1+1/(p-1), is asymptotic to log(p*rho)/(p-1), and converges to zero while exact finite-p support remains positive.

For every admitted first-zero cell, Lean derives the unique phase, unique boxed optimizer at every span, all three exact support regimes, phase-bit sufficiency for every binary support query, and an actual objective-level pair showing that the phase bit is necessary beyond K; the three registered fixtures remain exact.

Lean connects both declared real-power objectives to their unique optimizers and exact maximum-gap support laws, proves all-profile one-trigger winner equivalence, and derives the objective-level shortest opposite-trigger separator at K+1; the two registered fixtures remain exact.

The periodic analytic gauge, potential, and reversal are exact. For arbitrary complete box-path families, strict monotonicity and the shift law preserve winner predicates relative to separate baseline and transformed exact path-KKT contracts; conversely, complete free two-edge winner-probe equality forces the shift law relative to the corresponding two contracts.

The commensurate-load witness and star defect are exact. Two complete free-probe winner families force identity under separate baseline/transformed exact path-KKT contracts, continuity, F(0)=0 and irrational load ratio; complete degree-three star-winner equality separately forces identity under the two exact star-KKT contracts, continuity, oddness and nonzero load.

This status does not generalize the fixed registered audit to every finite audit or claim that accumulation is necessary or cardinality-minimal.

Exact monomial continuation gives a horizon-independent lower bound, every geometric prefix attains it, equality identifies the entire retained geometric profile, and the continuation coefficient is unique for every admitted real exponent.

For a finite homogeneous comparison family containing a nonzero target, event identity is equivalent to the positive-ray condition. Failure of that condition constructively yields a nonempty relatively open pairwise-only spherical gap and hence a strict probability overcount under every admitted normalized Haar-induced full-support spherical law; this is not a converse from equality under one arbitrary measure. At the registered radius-two fixture, a normalized interior direction has exact target slack 1/5 and excluded-comparison slack -3/10; a 1/100-radian angular ball lies inside a 1/100 chordal ball wholly contained in the gap, and the exact normalized-Haar mass of that chordal patch is positive. The registered radius-two probabilities and arccotangent form remain closed relative to the project-specific `RadiusTwoSphereFixtureCoordinateTransport` premise, which directly supplies the event-to-integral identities and does not identify the measure as canonical uniform/Haar.

The raw complete score rows, exact Euclidean and Frobenius projection reversals, intermediate shell separation, strict far-shell open patches, and a common two-atom spherical radial law under which both named errors are positive and their order reverses are kernel-checked.

The support gives a componentwise least exponent-clearing vector, coefficient denominators have a least common-multiple clearing factor, both factors are positive on the physical activity domain, and the open-cube closure clause is exact.

The result is ledger-relative, depends on the complete mixed jet rather than an arbitrary scalar directional jet, and does not claim that a nonseparating direction identifies the law.

The general analytic branch is closed relative only to the explicit inherited Rolle multiplicity theorem parameter `FoundAnalyticRolleMultiplicity001`; one-ray equality is not multivariate grammar equality.

For every nonempty finite fibre, arbitrary strictly positive masses realize exactly the intrinsic interior of its convex hull; independent two-fibre responses realize exactly the intrinsic interior of the closed response envelope. Equality of attainable response sets is therefore equivalent to equality of their closed envelopes, and robust nonnegative directions are exactly the envelope's nonnegative polar.
